title: Bug: time picker error
symptom: When entering a time offset for carbs, the displayed time can be off by one minute (e.g., entering 30 minutes shows 31, entering 29 shows 30). The error seems to depend on the actual time in seconds.
cause: The time offset is the primary source and during conversion between offset and time, rounding occurs, causing a possible 1-minute difference.
fix: No fix was provided; the maintainer stated it is not a bug but a rounding issue during conversion.
evidence_quote: it's because time offiset is primary source and during conversion between offset and time rouding occur
